description.value: Signature Trait. A Revenant does not die easily. When reduced to 0 Stamina, instead of the normal dying procedure you collapse inert - prone, aware of your surroundings, unable to speak, act, or move. While inert you cannot be finished by ordinary means; after a period of rest (a respite, or roughly a scene of safety) you rise again at your Recovery value. Each time you are reduced to 0 Stamina and rise, your flesh decays a little more (narrative, feeds the Decay ladder). Fire and consecrated/annihilating damage are the exception - see True Death: a Revenant reduced to 0 Stamina who then takes fire damage while inert, or who suffers consecrated/annihilating destruction, is ended permanently.
